open_points.subject: deliver_project_photo
open_points.text: Without a placement it MUST call the imported read_named_source once with the photo folder and the name and answer with _failed: the NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT member of = models.PlacementFailure when it returns None; for a rejected SourceFile, the PlacementFailure member whose value equals its reason; the SOURCE_CHANGED member when the hashlib.sha256 hexdigest of the bytes read differs from the source id; the reason of a Rejected that _place raises; and the UNREADABLE_FILE member when _place raises OSError; otherwise it MUST answer the PLACED member with the placement _place returns and no photo_id, leaving any existing mark as it is.
open_points.other_text: - SourceRead fields (exact, no others exist): content: bytes | None, source: SourceFile
open_points.question: Must a non-None SourceRead always contain bytes, or must the note specify handling when content is None instead of hashing it or passing it to _place?

open_points.subject: _place
open_points.text: _place: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST call the imported prepare_photo with raw, the modified of source and the timezone of context, then the imported store_image with its content, then the imported build_publication, and write with the imported write_placement a PhotoPlacement of the project id and source id, the name of source, the reference store_image returned, the hashlib.sha256 hexdigest and the length of the stored bytes, the imported STORED_MEDIA_TYPE constant as media_type, the date_source of the prepared photo and the publication, returning that placement; an exception raised by any of these calls MUST pass to the caller unchanged.

Нота остаётся требованием к

микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the dotted hashlib.sha256 implementation expression with a declared imported symbol or a behavioral requirement that contains no expression or dotted navigation.

open_points.subject: _require_source_id
open_points.text: _require_source_id: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return None only when the whole source id matches the imported SOURCE_ID_PATTERN constant with re.fullmatch, and MUST raise DelivererError with the INVALID_SOURCE_ID member of = models.RefusalCode otherwise; the source id never becomes part of a path before this check.

open_points.question: Replace re.fullmatch with a declared imported validation operation or describe whole-pattern matching without dotted navigation or an inline call expression.

open_points.rule:
Таблица — это когда по
  члену перечисления выбирается значение: член другого перечисления, код,
  категория. Такое соответствие — само значение, таблица соответствий, даже
  когда оно сводится к «один член — одно, остальные — другое»; подмножество
  членов, задающее категорию, — allow-list. Код читает их как константу
  поставщика данных (§15.3.1, §6.10), а не как прозу рядом с `= models.X`.
open_points.question: Replace the inline ObservationReason-to-PlacementFailure correspondence with the name of an imported provider constant containing that mapping.
